title: Qualify timing budgets on the existing single-pass measurement
objective: Extend the timing validator to consume the already-produced incremental-validation JSON, add adversarial budget probes, and wire exactly two bootstrap checks so the routine path is measured once and budget-qualified without rerunning T0/T1/T2.
non_goals: rerun incremental validation for timing qualification
change timing budgets without a demonstrated defect

required_invariants: the production timing gate consumes the JSON emitted by the existing single-pass step rather than executing validation again
measurement validation is fail-closed for routine paths and explicitly not-applicable for pytest-backed/non-routine paths
budget policy remains unchanged unless qualification demonstrates a policy defect
bootstrap adds exactly one measurement-enforcement step and one adversarial-selftest step
no new workflow dependency network access or paid service is introduced
acceptance_criteria: single-pass step writes its existing JSON output to an ephemeral file with tee
timing validator accepts a measurement-file mode and validates policy before measurement
current routine measurement passes T0 T1 T2 and total budgets
adversarial suite covers each stage over-budget missing/invalid timing non-routine applicability policy ceiling and ordering
adversarial suite contains at least 12 focused probes
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head

target_commands: bootstrap measurement enforcement on existing single-pass JSON

done_when: current single-pass routine measurement passes timing budgets without tier recomputation
at least 12 adversarial timing probes pass
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head
ENG-08.1 can transition to ENG-08.2 without changing validation semantics
